title: Technical Documentation, README and API Usage Guides
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose and value of Technical Documentation, README and API Usage Guides.
Apply technical documentation, readme and api usage guides to a Python project scenario.
Identify decisions and trade-offs relevant to technical documentation, readme and api usage guides.
Review common mistakes and risks in technical documentation, readme and api usage guides.
Produce a verifiable project artifact using technical documentation, readme and api usage guides principles.

understand.concept: Technical documentation explains a project's purpose, setup, usage, interfaces, design choices and operational requirements. A README is a concise starting point, while API references and architecture notes provide detail. Good documentation stays aligned with code and avoids exposing secrets.
understand.whyItMatters: Documentation lowers the cost of using, reviewing, operating and maintaining software.
understand.analogy: An instruction manual helps another person operate and maintain a device without asking its designer each time.
understand.analogyLimit: Documentation can become stale and needs ownership and verification alongside code changes.
understand.summary: Technical Documentation, README and API Usage Guides helps learners plan and deliver maintainable Python projects.

explain.narrative: Lead with purpose and audience. Include prerequisites, installation, safe configuration, commands, example usage and test instructions. Document public functions and design constraints. Review docs whenever interfaces or setup steps change.

examples.title: README outline
examples.explanation: A README covers common reader tasks.

examples.title: Docstring
examples.code:
def percentage(part, whole):
    """Return part as a percentage of whole."""
    return part / whole * 100
print(percentage.__doc__)
examples.expectedOutput: Return part as a percentage of whole.

examples.title: Safe configuration
examples.explanation: Docs should not contain real secrets.

examples.title: API consistency
examples.explanation: Documentation should match the public interface.

practise.guidedTask: Draft a README outline for a Python contact manager.
practise.independentTask: Write a docstring explaining purpose, parameters, return value and exceptions.
hints: Lead with purpose and intended audience.
